notes.title: Discover the ENDLESS LOOP!
notes.notes:
[p]M.E.G. Agents, prepare to cross a new frontier!
The Backrooms open up to a dark and uncharted parallel world: the [b]ENDLESS LOOP[/b] mode.[/p][p]In this unstable universe, every run is a unique instance—an endless raid where the difficulty intensifies the further you go. The longer you survive, the greater the danger becomes. But that’s not all: entities now feature reworked behaviors, making every encounter more unpredictable. If you’re looking for a real challenge, you’ll find plenty here.[/p][p]And because good news never comes alone, ENDLESS LOOP also brings [b]exclusive content[/b]. While exploring, you may stumble upon MEG crates packed with equipment and relics, granting access to brand-new skins (unlocked in-game, with no microtransactions).[/p][p][/p][h3]How does ENDLESS LOOP work?[/h3][p]To help you dive right into the experience, here are the key points to remember:[/p][list][*][p][b]Progression automatically saved[/b]: your progress is recorded after each completed level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]XP that matters everywhere[/b]: experience earned in Endless Loop helps you explore the entire Backrooms: Extractions universe more effectively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory reset at entry[/b]: everything is wiped at the start of each run, but don’t worry—your normal inventory is restored when you exit Endless.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crates to hunt down[/b]: hidden throughout this unstable world, they contain tools, gear, and sometimes rare relics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Relics with unique rewards[/b]: collect them to unlock exclusive skins in the LAB shop—though only the luckiest will succeed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Step into infinity[/h3][p]In short, [b]ENDLESS LOOP[/b] is a true invitation to push your limits.
So, step into the LAB elevator and embark on this never-ending mission.
The real question is… will you make it out?[/p]

notes.title: "Endless Loop": Try the new game mode
notes.notes:
[p]As we’re getting closer to the release of a major new update introducing the “Endless Loop” game mode, all game owners now get immediate access to the experimental build![/p][h2]
How to install the build[/h2][p]To access the experimental version:[/p][olist][*][p]Right-click on [i]Backrooms: Extractions[/i] → Properties → Betas,[/p][/*][*][p]In the “Private Betas” field, enter the code: [b]liminalspaces[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]Then, open the dropdown menu above (“Beta Participation”) and select [b]Experimental[/b],[/p][/*][/olist][p] [b]That’s it! The experimental version will download. [/b] To return to the normal version, simply set “Beta Participation” back to [b]None[/b]. [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]What’s new in this build[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Endless Loop mode,[/p][/*][*][p]New skins,[/p][/*][*][p]M.E.G Crates spawning in Endless mode (rare ones contain Relics, which can be used to purchase skins in the LAB),[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]We’d love your feedback on:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Difficulty in Endless Loop and how it scales over levels,[/p][/*][*][p]Entity presence, behavior, and challenge level,[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs,[/p][/*][*][p]Visual quality and artistic choices for skins (both roleplay-oriented and fun ones),[/p][/*][*][p]Relics drop rates,[/p][/*][*][p]M.E.G Credits quantity and skin pricing (in M.E.G Credits. No microtransaction)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]Good to know[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Skin purchasing and equipping is still very basic, so don’t worry about the UX for now.,[/p][/*][*][p]Endless menus are bare-bones (just buttons for now). These will be polished before the public update.,[/p][/*][/list][p] Enjoy and can't wait to get your feedback![/p][p]Mat[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: The Suburbs
notes.notes: During the blackout event, the number of entities spawning in the "Suburbs" level is once again scaled according to the game's difficulty.

notes.title: Hotfix: Private Match Code
notes.notes:
You can now join private games using 8-digit codes.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Hotfix: Private Match Code

The generated code for private matches is now correct.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Major Early Access Update
notes.notes: [p]We are excited to announce a new version of Backrooms: Extractions! A huge thank you to all players for your valuable suggestions and feedback. Your support is essential in continually improving the game![/p][p]This update completely renews the game's main mode, emphasizing exploration, rewards, progression, and automatic saving of all your in-game actions. Additionally, this version sets the foundation for future game modes, levels, and creatures.[/p][p]A special message to players familiar with Infinite mode: INFINITE LOOP is currently undergoing a complete overhaul and will soon return in an even more enjoyable and challenging version! 🙂[/p][h2][b]NEW GAME MODE[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The main menu has been replaced by LAB: Immediately take control of your character and start or create a game session via the control panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Your character evolves with each session, and progress is saved automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn experience points and in-game currency for every successfully completed mission—as long as you survive...[/p][/*][*][p]Receive additional experience points and currency based on your performance, successful extractions, and your team's status when closing the Quantum Portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock new Backrooms levels based on your rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Access new tools based on your rank and purchase them with in-game currency.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]LAB UPDATE[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Coming soon in LAB: Character customization and a bestiary to help you discover the secrets and behaviors of creatures.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UPCOMING CONTENT[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New levels, two of which are already in the testing phase.[/p][/*][*][p]New creatures, three of which are already being tested and developed.[/p][/*][*][p]New tools, including upgrades to existing tools and entirely new gameplay mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to gameplay, level design, and sound design for an even more intense and frightening experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for your support and feedback! Stay tuned for more exciting updates![/p][p]Mat, Backrooms: Extractions[/p]

notes.title: Sales and Upcoming Update!
notes.notes: [h2]Enjoy the sales to discover Backrooms: Extractions![/h2][p]From June 26 to July 10, 2025, take advantage of the Steam Sales to play Backrooms: Extractions and discover this first Early Access version![/p][h2]Major update in a few days[/h2][p]Available since April 30, we've made several fixes and analyzed community feedback. We're currently working on the game's next update, launching in a few days, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]A new, more challenging game mode, fully replacing Quick Game. Quickly explore all levels now—things won't be so easy later![/p][/*][*][p]An XP system to unlock new levels and tools in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Persistent progress across games: money, XP, tools[/p][/*][*][p]A new level extremely rare in Backrooms games[/p][/*][*][p]New entities linked to the new level[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for helping us improve the game during Early Access![/p][p]See you soon, and enjoy the game :)[/p]

notes.title: Enhanced survival, tactical painting: exciting new features!
notes.notes:
Check out the latest features and improvements enhancing your game experience!

New features:
- PaintGun Advanced: a new tool allowing you to select from multiple emissive paint colors, essential for clear and precise tactical marking during your explorations.
- Self-Revive Kit: a crucial new tool for improved survival, automatically reviving you after an entity attack, provided you acquired it beforehand.

Adjustments:
- The standard PaintGun no longer supports emissive painting. This feature is now exclusively available with the PaintGun Advanced.
- Added an integrated statistics screen directly in the M.E.G Lab (formerly Quantum Room), allowing better tracking of your progress and performance.

Thank you for your continued support and happy exploring!

notes.title: Improvements and bug fixes based on your feedback
notes.notes:
- Dead players in the level are now returned to the Quantum Room (Lab) when a player arms the console.

- Began improvements to the M.E.G Lab (Quantum Room) for future new features.

- Added an indicator showing the key to exit vehicles.

- Modified camera behavior when sprinting (removes the unintended crouching effect).

- Fixed contextual text under the Emotes radial menu.

- Fixed the stress level randomly reaching 100% for certain players.

- Fixed item dropping not working properly in certain locations.

Thank you for helping us make Backrooms: Extractions even better!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: - The signal can now be sent by all players in the Attic Floorboards level.

notes.title: Player inventory drop fix upon death (0.1.64)
notes.notes: In multiplayer, when a player dies or leaves the game, all items from their inventory (except the camera and PDA) now correctly spawn on the ground. The team can pick them up to properly finish ongoing missions and continue using the tools.

notes.title: Improved Smiler behavior, PDA and AI! (0.1.62)
notes.notes:
- Smiler behavior updated:
It now attacks only if directly illuminated by your flashlight or if you're very close, preventing unexpected attacks.

- Smiler visual upgrade:
Started redesigning the Smiler's appearance to make it darker and more menacing.

- PDA improvements:
Improved signal handling to clarify signal location. After data is sent, the PDA stops searching and displays a notification.

- Entity behavior optimization:
Entities now spend less time near players who just hid.

- AI pathfinding fixes:
Fixed occasional AI blocking issues. If you still encounter this, please send us a detailed bug report (level, entities involved, etc.).

Thank you again for your valuable feedback!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optimization
notes.notes:
- Signal transmission zones are now stable.
- Various fixes and optimizations for improved performance.

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes (Suburbs and Habitable Zone)
notes.notes:
- Fixed vehicle replication (Suburbs and Habitable Zone).
- Improved crate spawning (Habitable Zone).
- The main TV in Suburbs no longer displays a default color.
- Language selection is now directly available via the ESC key.
- Fixed the display of available microphones in the options menu.

notes.title: Hotfix for Suburbs map
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the actor containing TVs and VCRs would sometimes not spawn.
Thanks to "why you bully me" for reporting this bug!

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes (0.1.51)
notes.notes:
- The radial menu no longer closes automatically after dropping an item.
- Fixed the character unintentionally performing a mantle action at various locations, causing players to get stuck.
- Fixed entities getting stuck in certain locations within the Suburbs level.
- Modified the Push To Talk system. Three modes are now available in settings: Off, Push To Talk, and Open Mic.

We also take this opportunity to thank you for your many positive feedback messages. They greatly motivate us! Thanks!

notes.title: Hotfix Push To Talk
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue preventing the Push To Talk key from being bound on certain keyboards.

notes.title: Fixes: Collisions, Mouse Settings, and Client/Server Actor Consistency
notes.notes:
- Mouse sensitivity setting now correctly applies to both axes and upon game launch.
- Players can no longer get stuck in the rocks in the Paradise level.
- The new actor spawning logic continues to roll out across different levels. The issue where clients saw more actors than the server should no longer occur.

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Fixes based on your valuable feedback!
notes.notes:
- Fixed the bug causing closets (hiding spots) to sometimes be out of sync across multiple levels.
- Improved Push To Talk (you can now enable or disable it in settings and customize the associated key).

Thanks again!

notes.title: Update for Level 0 - Lobby and Level Utility Halls
notes.notes:
- Optimized spawning of certain mission-related actors. Some players could see more items than were actually available on the server.
Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Advanced Graphics Settings and Fixes
notes.notes:
- Added advanced graphics settings support, including Nvidia DLSS, AMD FSR, TSR, and Intel XESS.
- Fixed a bug in Level Fun where mission tracking showed more collected items than actually obtained.

notes.title: Chinese Language Fix
notes.notes: - The scoreboard at the end of the game now correctly displays all characters.

notes.title: Level Fun and Habitable Zone Improvements
notes.notes:
- The final door leading to the Quantum Room in Level Fun is now locked. Completing the musical puzzle is now mandatory.
- Improved spawn diversity for extraction targets and drink dispensers in Habitable Zone level.

notes.title: Almond Water Dispensers
notes.notes: - Added almond water dispensers in the Quantum Room (soon to become the "M.E.G Lab" in an upcoming major update). Thanks to players for suggesting this great quality-of-life improvement! In Infinity Loop mode, this allows you to recover before using the shop.

notes.title: Unstuck Me (Early Access feature), fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
- Added a feature to unstuck your character when you're stuck with another player (default key is B, customizable in settings). If this happens, please send us a detailed bug report, as this issue is difficult to reproduce.
- Adjusted the level initialization system to prevent an issue where several players saw actor spawn points without interaction. Affected elements include extraction targets, almond water dispensers, wooden planks, cutters, roots, and the scene with the table (Paradise). If you encounter problems, please submit a bug report.
- Various minor fixes and optimizations.

Thank you for helping us continually improve the Early Access experience!

notes.title: Hotfix: Level Fun
notes.notes: - Fixed a collision preventing players from accessing part of the level.

notes.title: Hotfix: Skin Stealer and Camera
notes.notes:
- The Skin Stealer was incorrectly appearing in the first difficulty level. This issue has now been fixed.
- Fixed the Camera tool flipping issue occurring at certain screen resolutions.

notes.title: Improvements, Balancing and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Balancing:
- The number of Partygoers in the Fun level is now better adjusted based on the selected difficulty.

Fixes and Improvements:
- Pickable items are now translated in-game.
- Added an icon indicating how to unequip the PDA while holding the tablet.
- Added UI feedback when validating a mission.
- Increased Paint Gun range (by 1 meter).
- Fixed a bug that caused some players to get stuck in vehicles.

notes.title: SOS Transmitter Improvements, Fixes, and Optimizations
notes.notes:
- You now exit hiding spots, such as ball pits or vehicles, in the direction you are looking. This new system should also fix the issue where some players got stuck inside.
- Fixed a corner in the Paradise level where players could become stuck.
- The SOS Transmitter can now be picked up after being deployed.

notes.title: Fixes Based on Player Feedback (thank you!)
notes.notes:
- The level "The End" (Level 601) is temporarily disabled for rework (previously required a high stress level to access).
- Fixed an issue in the computer room of the "Habitable Zone" (Level 1) that could cause players to become stuck.
- Fixed a bug that could trap players inside vehicles.
- Various minor fixes and performance optimizations.

notes.title: Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Added[/h2]
- Mission display toggle indicator.
- Alert message system.

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
- Color correction for floppy disks when thrown on the ground.
- Collision issues with the new walls in Level 0: Lobby.

notes.title: Smilers Improvement and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]New Update:[/h2]
- Smiler: Can no longer attack players hidden in safe zones (cars, lockers, etc.).
- Fixed an issue where the "Join Private Game" button could become disabled.
- Resolution scale can now be set lower.
- Game version checks are now also performed in private matches and will notify players if an update is required. This should resolve unexpected returns to the lobby (please keep us informed).
- Collision issues fixed in Level 0 Lobby, addressing previous softlock reports.
- Fixed the elevator issue that prevented players from exiting.
- Fixed spectator mode when joining a game late: you can now access the menu and directly spectate a player.

[h2]Player Feedback Request:[/h2]
Please provide detailed information about the conditions in which you encounter the issue of characters getting stuck on each other. Your precise feedback helps us significantly. 
Thank you!

notes.title: Patch notes based on player feedback
notes.notes:
- You can now exit spectator mode when joining a game late.
- Fixed the elevator bug in Habitable Zone.
- Fixed collision issues on certain stairs in Level 0 Lobby.

notes.title: Hot Fix - Big report
notes.notes: Dedicated hotfix for implementing the bug reporting system to handle all alphabets.

notes.title: Chinese Translation Rework & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Corrected Chinese translation (thanks to "A Tom Cat" for their contribution!)
- Fixed a bug allowing the player to crouch inside the car and the ball pit
- Fixed a bug occurring when holding down the interaction key on certain actors

notes.title: Patch 0.1.15 - Ball pit and lobbies fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue preventing players from exiting the ball pit in Level Fun.
- Fixed outdated server version display, which could prevent players from joining lobbies.

Thank you all for your valuable feedback and continuous support!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.12 - In-Game Bug Reporting and Optimizations
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]
[b]In-Game Bug Reporting[/b]
Added a built-in bug report system, allowing players to submit tickets directly from within the game.

[b]Quantum Room Portal Optimization[/b]
Improved the performance of the portal in the Quantum Room for smoother loading and transitions.

[b]Stamina & Stress Mechanics[/b]
Players can now sprint for longer durations thanks to increased base endurance. However, stress levels now dynamically impact stamina recovery.

[h2]Fixes & General Optimizations[/h2]
Various bug fixes and stability improvements
Performance optimizations to reduce frame drops

notes.title: Balancing, Entities, Localization, and More! (v0.1.9)
notes.notes:
[h2]Localization[/h2]
  - Fixed an issue where the selected language wasn’t being saved.

[h2]Tools Renaming[/h2]
  - Updated the names of several in-game tools to better reflect their functionality.

[h2]Shop Descriptions[/h2]
  - Added explanatory descriptions for each tool in the shop, so players can make informed purchases.

[h2]Lobby Level Tweaks [/h2]
  - Adjusted exit door difficulty based on player feedback.

[h2]Server List Version Indicator[/h2]
  - Added a version badge in the lobby browser to warn players when they’re on an outdated build.

[h2]Item Spawn Balancing[/h2]
  - Fine-tuned item respawn rates and spawn points across multiple levels, following community suggestions.

[h2]Skin Stealer[/h2]
  - Now scales its difficulty with the overall match intensity, in response to player feedback.

[h2]Performance & Bug Fixes[/h2]
  - Various minor bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: Patch v 0.1.8 – Smiler Overhaul
notes.notes:
[h2]Increased Respawn Delay[/h2]
We’ve dialed back the frenzy by lengthening the time between each Smiler respawn—take a breather (or at least try to).

[h2]Extended Smiler Event Duration[/h2]
Once the Smiler shows up, it now sticks around a little longer. No more “blink and you missed it” surprises.

[h2]Line-of-Sight Fix[/h2]
The Smiler can no longer lunge through walls.

[h2]Reduced Spawn Radius Around Players[/h2]
Smilers now spawn closer to their designated zones instead of popping right in your face (most of the time).

[h2]Dynamic Smiler Count[/h2]
The number of Smilers per blackout now scales with both player count and chosen difficulty.

If you blind the Smiler with your flashlight or lean in for a closer look, it’ll still one-shot you. Some habits die hard!

notes.title: Balancing and improvements
notes.notes:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[h3]Skin Stealer[/h3]
Reworked to slightly reduce the difficulty in levels where it appears. Its pursuit AI and attack timings have been adjusted for a more manageable challenge.

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
Fixed various display issues in the HUD and loading screens.

[h2]PDA[/h2]
[h3]Signal Screen Feedback[/h3]
If the target has not yet been located, the PDA now clearly displays “Target not located” on the signal screen until the antenna is deployed near the extraction NPC.

notes.title: Quantum Room Overhaul & More!
notes.notes:
[h2]General[/h2]
- New version of the Quantum Room
- Added a 3-minute introduction on the first launch of the game
- Ability to join an already in-progress game (as a spectator for the current level)
- Added gameplay tips to the loading screens
- Improved radio effect

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Clicking the JOIN button without entering a code no longer sends you into a game
- Level “Paradise”: you can no longer complete the mission by spamming the interaction button

notes.title: Invite Code fix for private lobbies
notes.notes:
Private Match Invitation Code:
- Fixed an issue where the private match invitation code was not displaying correctly in the UI.
- The invitation code is now clearly visible in the private lobby screen.
- Added the ability to copy the invitation code directly to the clipboard with a single click.

This makes it much easier for players to share the code with friends through platforms like Discord or other messaging tools.

notes.title: First Improvements & Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Localization[/h2]
- General improvement of the game’s translation, including:
- Initial implementation of environmental elements
- Action/interaction buttons for in-game items

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- Fixed entities continuing to apply stress after disappearing
- Improved feedback from the Quantum Signal on the PDA

[h2]General[/h2]
- Improved tutorial
- Fixed the mouse sensitivity slider
- Various other background improvements

This is just the beginning. More updates and content are on the way!
Stay tuned :)

notes.title: The QWERTY patch
notes.notes:
Hotfix deployed: QWERTY is now the default.
Don’t panic, non-QWERTY warriors: the in-game settings still let you rebind your keys!
Happy extracting in the Backrooms.

notes.notes:

If you notice any bugs or translation issues, please let us know, we’re actively listening to your feedback and excited to keep improving the game together!
